Cancel a pending connection request started by\n `server connect`\n## `cloud projects servers` commands
\n\nManage the MCP servers saved in a project and connect new ones. All `projects servers` commands require an `sk_` API key (via

`--api-key` or the `MCPJAM_API_KEY` environment variable) or a prior `mcpjam cloud login`.

### Shared platform flags

| Flag

| Description |
| - | - |
| `--api-key <key>` | MCPJam `sk_` API key (overrides `MCPJAM_API_KEY`) |
| `--api-url <url>` | MCPJa
m API base URL (defaults to `https://app.mcpjam.com/api/v1`) |\n| `--api-header <header...>` | Extra request header as `\"Name: va
lue\"`, repeatable — for a deployment behind Cloudflare Access, a WAF, or a corporate proxy. Also `MCPJAM_API_HEADERS`, one per li

ne. Cannot set `authorization`, `idempotency-key`, or `content-type`. |

### `cloud projects servers connect`

Start a connect
ion request for an MCP server URL. Discovery, browser consent, and validation happen asynchronously. When the server requires OAut
h, the command prints a private authorization link and (by default) opens it in a browser. The command then polls until the reques

t reaches a terminal status.

| Flag | Required | Description |
| - | - | - |
| `--url <url>` | Yes | MCP server URL to connec
t |\n| `--project <id-or-name>` | No | Project name or ID |\n| `--server <id>` | No | Existing server ID, when the project has sev
eral on this URL |\n| `--name <name>` | No | Name for the server, if one is created |\n| `--reauthorize` | No | Force a fresh auth
orization |\n| `--no-browser` | No | Print the authorization link instead of opening it |\n| `--no-wait` | No | Return as soon as
the request is created |\n\nWith `--no-wait`, the command prints the request id and exits immediately. The request continues in th
e cloud; use `connect-status` to check it and `connect-cancel` to stop it.\n\nEach pending request holds one of the account's five
concurrent-connection slots for up to an hour. If `connect` reports `ACTIVE_REQUEST_LIMIT`, the error details include the ids of
the open requests — cancel the abandoned ones with `connect-cancel` to free slots.\n\n### `cloud projects servers connect-status`\

n
Check the current state of a connection request started by `connect`.

| Flag | Required | Description |
| - | - | - |

-request <id>` | Yes | Connection request id (`scr_…`) |

### `cloud projects servers connect-cancel`

Cancel a pending connec
tion request, releasing the concurrent-connection slot it holds. Cancelling an already-terminal request is a no-op.\n302:| `POST .

nning it; responds `201` + `suiteId`. Each test's case body is an ordered `steps` array (prompt / toolCall / interact / assert); p
er-test `model`/`provider`/`runs` are optional and fall back to suite defaults |\n332:| `POST .../agent` | Run ONE assistant turn
over a `messages` history (`{role: \"user\"\\|\"assistant\", content}` items, max 50 messages × 8 KB each, 96 KB total). The model
is pinned server-side and billed to the project. The turn can read project servers/suites/runs and **create eval suites**; it can
NOT start runs — kick those off yourself with `POST .../eval-runs`. Responds synchronously with `reply`, the `toolCalls` it made,
`createdResources` (ids + app links), and token `usage`. Capped at 4 concurrent turns per organization and \\~90 s wall clock. **
